name: linkedin-ai-agent
description: Autonomous AI agent for LinkedIn content creation and posting

scripts.build: echo && echo \* \* \* \* \* \* \* \* \* \* \* running build: build_alpha build_html build_js \* \* \* \* \* \* \* \* \* \* \* && npm run build_alpha && npm run build_html && npm run build_js && echo installed version $npm_package_name-$npm_package_version
scripts.production: export PGDATABASE=***REMOVED*** && export PGUSER=***REMOVED*** && npm run getvars && NODE_ENV=production npm run start
scripts.nonprod: export PGUSER=***REMOVED*** && npm run getvars && NODE_ENV=nonprod npm run nodemon
scripts.dev: export PGDATABASE=linkedin_dev && export PGUSER=***REMOVED*** && npm run getvars && NODE_ENV=dev DEV_BYPASS_ORIGINS=http://localhost:3001,http://127.0.0.1:3001,http://172.16.11.101:3001 DEV_BYPASS_SUB="***REMOVED***" npm run nodemon
scripts.extract-v: unzip -o "$(/bin/ls -tr /datavol/$npm_package_name/drop/*.zip|tail -1)" -d .. && v=$(basename $(/bin/ls -tr /datavol/$npm_package_name/drop/*.zip | tail -1));v=${v##*-};v=${v%.zip} && mkdir -p /datavol/$npm_package_name/drop/$v && unzip -o "$(/bin/ls -tr /datavol/$npm_package_name/drop/*.zip|tail -1)" -d /datavol/$npm_package_name/drop/$v && npm version $v && npm run build
scripts.zipsrc: npm run zipsrc-claude && zip -9 -r -y /datavol/$npm_package_name/drop/source/source-$npm_package_name-$npm_package_version.zip . -x "**/LinkedIn_Agent_Testing/*" -x "**/deploy/*" -x "**/testing/*" -x "**/migration/*" -x "**/.env" -x "**/docs/*" -x "docs/*" -x "**/pg.conf"  -x "**/.DS_Store" -x "**/*tmp*" -x "*tmp*" -x "**/.psqlrc" -x "**/bashrc-hook.sh" -x "bashrc-hook.sh"  -x "**/*.db*" -x "**/*.nogit*" -x "**/*.nogit*/*"  -x "**/*.md" -x "*.md" -x ".git/*" -x "**/.git/*" -x "**/node_modules/*"  -x "node_modules/*"  -x "**/.gitignore" -x "**/*.tar.gz" -x "**/*.log" -x "**/*.zip" -x "**/*.bak*" && echo && ls /datavol/$npm_package_name/drop/source/source-$npm_package_name-$npm_package_version.zip
scripts.zipall: npm run zipsrc && npm run zipdeploy && zip /datavol/$npm_package_name/drop/source/source-all-$npm_package_name-$npm_package_version.zip /datavol/$npm_package_name/drop/source/*-$npm_package_name-$npm_package_version.zip
scripts.zipall1: rm ../linkedin-agent/data/pgsql/data; rm ../linkedin-agent/data/pgsql/pgsql; zip -9 -r /datavol/$npm_package_name/drop/source/source-all-$npm_package_name-$npm_package_version.zip ../linkedin-agent/ -x "**/LinkedIn_Agent_Testing/*" -x "**/deploy/*" -x "**/migration/*" -x "**/.env" -x "**/docs/*" -x "**/pg.conf"  -x "**/.DS_Store" -x "**/*tmp*" -x "**/.psqlrc" -x "**/bashrc-hook.sh"  -x "**/*.db*" -x "**/*.nogit*" -x "**/*.nogit*/*"  -x "**/*.md" -x "**/.git/*" -x "**/node_modules/*"  -x "**/.gitignore" -x "**/*.tar.gz" -x "**/*.log" -x "**/*.zip" -x "**/*.bak*" && echo && echo /datavol/$npm_package_name/drop/source/source-all-$npm_package_name-$npm_package_version.zip; cd ../linkedin-agent/data/pgsql && ln -s . pgsql && ln -s pgsql data
scripts.zipall2: rm ../linkedin-agent/data/pgsql/data; rm ../linkedin-agent/data/pgsql/pgsql; zip -9 -r /datavol/$npm_package_name/drop/source/source-all-$npm_package_name-$npm_package_version.zip ../linkedin-agent/scripts/testing/ ../linkedin-agent/ ../LinkedIn_Agent_Deploy/ -x "**/migration/*" -x "**/.env" -x "**/docs/*" -x "**/pg.conf"  -x "**/.DS_Store" -x "**/*tmp*" -x "**/.psqlrc" -x "**/bashrc-hook.sh"  -x "**/*.db*" -x "**/*.nogit*" -x "**/*.nogit*/*"  -x "**/*.md" -x "**/.git/*" -x "**/node_modules/*"  -x "**/.gitignore" -x "**/*.tar.gz" -x "**/*.log" -x "**/*.zip" -x "**/*.bak*" && echo && echo /datavol/$npm_package_name/drop/source/source-all-$npm_package_name-$npm_package_version.zip; cd ../linkedin-agent/data/pgsql && ln -s . pgsql && ln -s pgsql data
scripts.getmodels: if [ -z "$APIKEY" ];then echo export APIKEY;fi && curl https://api.anthropic.com/v1/models   -H "x-api-key: $APIKEY" -H "anthropic-version: 2023-06-01"|jq
scripts.insert_test_memnership: . ../build/.env.pgsql-marketing_ai_instance.local && psql -c "INSERT INTO memberships (auth_provider, auth_sub, tenant_id, role) VALUES ('auth0', '$TEST_AUTH', '$TENANT_ID', 'owner') ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;"
scripts.linkedin-signout: . ../build/.env.pgsql-marketing_ai_instance.local && psql -c "DELETE FROM credentials WHERE tenant_id = '$TENANT_ID' AND key IN ('linkedin_access_token', 'linkedin_person_urn');" && npm run build
